Compliance Answer: Frequent reviews of compliance controls should be conducted by accountable and reporting institutions, with appropriate pre-validation to ensure timely accurate reporting as per MLTFC Regulations and Centre’s requirements.
Relevant Regulatory Basis: Source 1 (2019.03-Guidance-Draft-Guidance-Note-05C-CTRs.txt, Chunk 425)

This implies a continuous monitoring approach, although it does not specify an exact frequency within this context alone.
